snippet:
> For AI client integration (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), connect to the MCP server at https://mailchimp.com/developer/_mcp/server.
# MCP server
> Query these docs from an AI agent through the Model Context Protocol.
> **Note**
>
> **This searches documentation, not your Mailchimp account.** The server
> answers questions using this site's published content, so it works without a
> Mailchimp credential. To let an agent act on your account, call the API
> directly or use [Agent skills](/marketing/build/ai-tools/agent-skills).
[Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) (MCP) is an open
standard that lets an AI agent discover and call an external server's tools
during a conversation.
This documentation site is itself an MCP server. Connect an agent to it and
the agent can search these docs directly from your editor or terminal instead
of you copying passages into the conversation by hand.

**Claude Code**
```bash
claude mcp add --transport http fern_mcp_mailchimp-docs \
https://mailchimp.com/developer/_mcp/server
```
**Cursor**
Add the URL to your MCP server configuration:
```
https://mailchimp.com/developer/_mcp/server
```
**Claude Desktop**
Open Claude menu → Settings → Developer → Edit Config, then add the server
under `mcpServers` in `claude_desktop_config.json`:
```json
{
"mcpServers": {
"mailchimp-docs": {
"type": "http",
"url": "https://mailchimp.com/developer/_mcp/server"
}
}
}
```
**VS Code**
Add the same server to `.vscode/mcp.json` in your project:
```json
{
"servers": {
"mailchimp-docs": {
"type": "http",
"url": "https://mailchimp.com/developer/_mcp/server"
}
}
}
```
Restart the client after saving. Each one surfaces a connection indicator
once the server responds.
## Other ways agents can access these docs
An agent can also read this site directly. Every page has a Markdown
version at its own URL with `.md` appended, and an `llms.txt` index lists
those pages at every level of the docs, down to individual sections. This
works the same way on authenticated documentation sites and public ones like
this one.
```bash
curl https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/build/ai-tools/mcp-server.md
```

title: How to Use Mailchimp's Transactional Messaging MCP
snippet:
An [MCP (Model Context Protocol)](https://modelcontextprotocol.info/) allows AI agents to interact with API, knowledge bases, or other content. Our MCP specifically allows you to interact with the Transactional Messaging API, give onboarding help regarding Transactional Messaging, and submit feedback.
## What can the MCP do?
Our MCP mirrors what our API can already do.
| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| account_status | Check account status |
| build_template | Build/construct a template |
| call_api | Call a Transactional Messaging API endpoint |
| describe_api | Describe a specific API endpoint (parameters, schema) |
| diagnose_failed_send | Diagnose why a send failed |
| integrate_api | Help integrate with the API |
| list_api | List available Transactional Messaging API endpoints |
| onboarding | Onboarding assistance |
| submit_feedback | Submit feedback |

If you want to only allow the API key to use certain API calls **and** be able to use the MCP, the API key permissions must have the “AI Agents” group enabled.

snippet:
# mcp-mailchimp
Production-grade MCP server for the [Mailchimp Marketing API](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/). 71 tools covering campaigns, audiences, members, tags, segments, templates, reports, automations, webhooks, merge fields, interest groups, landing pages, batch operations, e-commerce, A/B testing, member notes, file manager, and audience analytics.
Built for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, and any MCP-compatible client.
## Quick Start
### 1. Install
```bash
pip install mcp-mailchimp
```
Or from source:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/AlexlaGuardia/mcp-mailchimp.git
cd mcp-mailchimp
pip install .
```
### 2. Get Your API Key
1. Log in to [Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com)
2. Go to **Account & Billing** > **Extras** > **API Keys**
3. Click **Create A Key**
4. Copy the key (format: `xxxxxxxxxx-usXX`)
### 3. Configure Your Client
**Claude Desktop** (`claude_desktop_config.json`):
```json
{
"mcpServers": {
"mailchimp": {
"command": "mcp-mailchimp",
"env": {
"MAILCHIMP_API_KEY": "your-api-key-here"
}
}
}
}
```
**Claude Code:**
```bash
claude mcp add mailchimp -- env MAILCHIMP_API_KEY=your-key mcp-mailchimp
```
**Cursor** (`.cursor/mcp.json`):
```json
{
"mcpServers": {
"mailchimp": {
"command": "mcp-mailchimp",
"env": {
"MAILCHIMP_API_KEY": "your-api-key-here"
}
}
}
}
```
Or run directly:
```bash
MAILCHIMP_API_KEY=your-key mcp-mailchimp
```

## Requirements
- Python 3.10+
- Mailchimp account with API key
- MCP-compatible client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.)
## Development
```bash
git clone https://github.com/AlexlaGuardia/mcp-mailchimp.git
cd mcp-mailchimp
pip install -e ".[dev]"
pytest
```

title: Mailchimp MCP Servers: Tools, Setup and Security
snippet:
Mailchimp has three official MCP options: a Claude campaign connector, a Transactional (Mandrill) server and a docs server. See tools, setup and limits.

Mailchimp has three official MCP options, and they do different jobs. The Intuit Mailchimp connector in Claude plans and builds campaigns. The Mailchimp Transactional server, at `https://mandrillapp.com/mcp`, works with the Mandrill email API. A third server only searches Mailchimp's developer docs.

- Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill) has its own server with 9 tools, including `call_api`, which can send email.
- The Transactional server uses a Mandrill API key. Restricted keys need the "AI Agents" permission group.
- The developer docs server at `https://mailchimp.com/developer/_mcp/server` only searches documentation.
## At a glance
| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Publisher | Intuit Mailchimp |
| Official? | Yes |
| Hosting | Remote URLs (hosted by Mailchimp) |
| Transport | HTTP |
| Sign-in | Connector: Mailchimp sign-in. Transactional: API key as Bearer token |
| Read or write | Connector saves drafts; Transactional can call any API endpoint |
| Price | No separate MCP price listed |
| Source code | Not published |
| Status | Connector added to Claude's directory March 2026 |

### Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill) server
The [Transactional guide](https://mailchimp.com/developer/transactional/guides/how-to-use-mailchimps-transactional-messaging-mcp/) lists 9 tools: `account_status`, `build_template`, `call_api`, `describe_api`, `diagnose_failed_send`, `integrate_api`, `list_api`, `onboarding` and `submit_feedback`. It says the server "mirrors what our API can already do." Its example prompts include sending a test email and pulling open and click metrics.

**Connector in Claude.** Mailchimp's steps are short: open Connectors in Claude, find Mailchimp, select Connect, and sign in with your Intuit Mailchimp account. You need a user role that can authorize third-party integrations in both products, usually Owner or Admin.
**Transactional server.** First create a Mandrill API key and authenticate a sending domain. For Claude Code, Mailchimp documents:
```bash
claude mcp add --transport http mctx-mcp https://mandrillapp.com/mcp \
-H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```
For Cursor, add this to `~/.cursor/mcp.json`:
```json
{
"mcpServers": {
"mctx-mcp": {
"type": "http",
"url": "https://mandrillapp.com/mcp",
"headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" }
}
}
}
```

title: Mailchimp MCP server review: official URL and setup for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor
snippet:
# Mailchimp MCP server
Yes. Mailchimp publishes an official MCP server at https://mandrillapp.com/mcp. It's hosted and connects with an API key from your Mailchimp account. It offers 9 tools. We last checked it on 11 Nov 2026.
Official: answers MCP requests at mandrillapp.com. Checked 11 Nov 2026. Maintained by [Stuart Brameld](https://martechdb.com/methodology#who).

### Does Mailchimp have an official MCP server?
Yes. Mailchimp publishes its MCP server itself. Its address is on Mailchimp's own domain (mandrillapp.com). MartechDB only lists servers a vendor publishes, never community copies.
### What is the Mailchimp MCP server URL?
The address is https://mandrillapp.com/mcp.

In Claude, add https://mandrillapp.com/mcp as a custom connector (Customize, Connectors, Add custom connector). In Cursor, use the Add to Cursor link on MartechDB's page, or paste the JSON settings into your mcp.json. In Claude Code, run: claude mcp add --transport http mailchimp https://mandrillapp.com/mcp
